description:
Proposed Development Description

The proposal comprises the construction of a single-storey outbuilding to the rear garden of the property , together with the replacement of the existing front entrance door, adjacent side window, and garage doors.

Rear Garden Outbuilding

The proposed outbuilding will be positioned within the rear corner of the garden out of the site of neighbouring properties, this will be used for purposes of enjoyment outside of the main dwelling, specifically as a home office and fitness space.

The structure will measure approximately 3.5 metres in width, 3.2 metres in depth, and will have a maximum height of 2.4 metres. The roof will be of a mono-pitch design, sloping from front to rear.

The building will be constructed using a timber frame system with appropriate insulation incorporated within the walls, floor, and roof to ensure thermal efficiency and year-round usability. The external walls will be finished in either horizontal timber slatted cladding or composite slatted cladding panels, selected to provide a high-quality and durable appearance that complements the residential setting.

The roof covering will be formed using EPDM rubber membrane or high-performance roofing felt, designed to provide a durable and weather-resistant finish.

Replacement Front Door, Side Window, and Garage Doors

The proposal also includes the replacement of the existing front entrance door, adjacent side window, and garage doors. These elements will be replaced on a like-for-like basis in terms of design, proportions, and materials.

The new installations will be constructed from timber and finished in white paint to match the existing appearance of the property. All glazing will be upgraded to modern double-glazed units to improve thermal performance and energy efficiency while maintaining the established character of the dwelling.

Summary

The proposed works are modest in scale and designed to be in keeping with the character and appearance of the existing property and its surroundings. The outbuilding will remain subordinate to the main dwelling and will not adversely impact neighbouring amenity.
